paragraphs: R' Yose, son of R' Yaakov bar Zavdi.
Mentioned in Peah, chapter 1, halakhah 5, where he reported in the name of R' Abbahu.[^1]

notes.text: פ״א ה״ה explicitly gives chapter 1, halakhah 5. A Jerusalem Talmud reading is suggested by the format, without an explicit corpus or independently checked edition. Yose reports Abbahu; the three-generation patronymic remains. All three personal title components remain R'.
